questions.title: Most Patent Grants
questions.prompt: Rank US states by number of utility patents granted to inventors residing in the state.
questions.disclaimer: Counts utility patents granted; assigned to the state of the first-named inventor. Includes Washington DC.

questions.title: Most Craft Breweries
questions.prompt: Rank US states by total number of operating craft breweries.
questions.disclaimer: Includes microbreweries, brewpubs, taproom, and regional craft breweries; excludes AB InBev / MillerCoors macro plants. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: Brewers Association — State Craft Beer Stats

questions.title: Highest Cost of Living
questions.prompt: Rank US states (and DC) by highest overall cost-of-living index.
questions.disclaimer: Composite index (US average = 100); combines grocery, housing, utilities, transport, health, and misc. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: Missouri Economic Research and Information Center (MERIC)

questions.title: Most Airports
questions.prompt: Rank US states by total number of public-use airports registered with the FAA.
questions.disclaimer: Counts all public-use airports (including general aviation), not just those with scheduled commercial service. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: FAA — National Plan of Integrated Airport Systems (NPIAS)

questions.title: Most Cattle
questions.prompt: Rank US states by total cattle and calves inventory.
questions.disclaimer: Includes all cattle and calves (beef and dairy); inventory as of January 1. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

questions.title: Highest Corn Production
questions.prompt: Rank US states by total corn (grain) production.
questions.disclaimer: Corn for grain only (excludes silage); measured in bushels. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: USDA NASS — Crop Production 2024 Summary (2023 crop year figures)

questions.title: Highest Hog Inventory
questions.prompt: Rank US states by total hogs and pigs inventory.
questions.disclaimer: Inventory of all hogs and pigs; the top state produces roughly a third of the national total. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: USDA NASS — Quick Stats (Hogs and Pigs)

questions.title: Largest Wine Production
questions.prompt: Rank US states by total wine production (excluding California, which alone produces over 80% of US wine).
questions.disclaimer: California is deliberately excluded to make the ranking competitive; measured in gallons produced. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: Wine Institute — Wine Production by State

questions.title: Largest Federal Workforce per Capita
questions.prompt: Rank US states (and DC) by federal civilian employees per 10,000 residents.
questions.disclaimer: Federal civilian executive-branch employees per 10,000 residents; excludes military and postal service. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM) — FedScope

questions.title: Highest Violent Crime Rate
questions.prompt: Rank US states (and DC) by highest violent crime rate per 100,000 residents.
questions.disclaimer: Violent crime = murder, rape, robbery, aggravated assault. Per 100,000 population. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: FBI — Uniform Crime Reporting / Crime Data Explorer

questions.title: Highest Median Rent
questions.prompt: Rank US states (and DC) by highest median gross monthly rent for occupied units.
questions.disclaimer: Median gross rent (contract rent plus utilities) for renter-occupied housing units. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: U.S. Census Bureau — American Community Survey (ACS 1-Year)

questions.title: Most Highway Miles per Capita
questions.prompt: Rank US states by miles of public road per 1,000 residents (highest first).
questions.disclaimer: All public roads (rural + urban, all functional classes) divided by state population, expressed per 1,000 residents. Includes Washington DC.

questions.title: Most Federally-Owned Public Land
questions.prompt: Rank US states by percentage of total land area owned by the federal government.
questions.disclaimer: Includes BLM, USFS, NPS, FWS, and DoD holdings; expressed as a percent of the state's total land area. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: Congressional Research Service — Federal Land Ownership

questions.title: Most Retail Sales per Capita
questions.prompt: Rank US states (and DC) by highest per-capita retail sales.
questions.disclaimer: Total retail sales divided by resident population; low-population, tourism-heavy states punch above their weight. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: U.S. Census Bureau — Monthly Retail Trade (state retail sales)

questions.title: States with the fewest neighbors
questions.prompt: Name the US states that share a land border with the fewest other US states.
questions.disclaimer: Counts land borders only; states separated only by water are not counted as neighbors. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: Wikipedia — List of states and territories of the United States

questions.title: States with the lowest point below sea level
questions.prompt: Name the US states whose lowest elevation point sits below sea level.
questions.disclaimer: Ranked by depth below sea level; rank 1 is the deepest below sea level. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: USGS — Elevations and Distances in the United States
